invariants.rationale: Method postWrite should not return null as result is expected to be a List<WriteStatus> after a write operation.
preppedRecords is an input to bulkInsertPreppedRecords and is required for the operation.
instantTime is used as a commit marker and passed to various sub-methods, so it must not be null.
The return type is guaranteed as List<WriteStatus>.
If result is not empty, it should contain WriteStatus objects reflecting the outcome of the write.
